title: 第15章 这种爹请给我来一打第16章 装就要装一个巅峰不败
content_zh:
数息后，许小凡吐血倒飞！
红衣老者冷哼一声。
“小子天赋不错。
如果再等几年，我可能不是你的一合之敌。
但现在，你不是我的对手！”
说着，低头看了一眼自己胸口塌陷的位置。
“你最好把你刚刚使用的战技交出来，否则我必要你看看老夫的手段！”
......
与此同时，天空之上，注意到儿子那边情况的许渊眼中闪过一抹杀意！
再次朝着花万仙一拳打去！
后者冷笑一声，持剑抵挡！
然而下一刻，人剑一起倒飞出去！
空中，花万仙吐出一口鲜血，接着狠狠砸在地上，手中剑，也插在脑袋旁边的地板上。
她想要再次起身，可身体却已经不听使唤。
甚至燃烧精血，强行使用虚空传送都没有办法！
怎么可能！
为什么又突然变强了！
她满脸不可置信！
这时，许渊已经来到他身边。
从她脑袋边，将那柄有着血色凹槽，整体散发着诡异红芒的剑握在手中。

许渊的手拂过灵剑，一道剑鸣之音响彻天地！
好似是这柄剑，在高兴的呐喊！
先天剑体，可令万剑臣服！
将剑握在手中，许渊俯视女子道：“这剑叫什么？”
花万仙嘴里不断涌出鲜血，她绝望盯着那袭青衫道：
“剑名，花晨。”
花晨？
月夕花晨！
许渊琢磨了一下这个名字，随即摇头道：“太难听了，以后叫血杀吧。”
血杀剑再次颤动发出剑鸣，似乎是对新名字表示满意！
花万仙不可置信的盯着这剑，“这剑有灵？”
她用这剑数年，杀人无数，竟从来不知！
许渊笑道：“万剑皆有灵，只是你还不配让他认主罢了。”
话罢，一剑斩下！
花万仙，香消玉殒！
来不及可惜，下一刻许渊的身形已经出现许小凡面前！
这时，红衣老者已经准备动手！
但旁边突然多出一个人，还是把他吓的愣在原地，“你...”
许渊皱眉道：“你刚刚说，让谁生不如死？”
红衣老者感受到面前青衫男子的气息，吓的浑身一哆嗦。
content_en:
After a few breaths, Xu Xiaofan vomited blood and flew backwards!
The old man in red snorted coldly.
“The boy has good talent.
If you wait a few more years, I may not be your enemy.
But now, you are no match for me! "
As he said that, he looked down at the sunken position of his chest.
"You'd better hand over the combat skills you just used, otherwise I'll need you to see what I can do!"
...
At the same time, in the sky, Xu Yuan, who noticed the situation on his son's side, flashed a murderous intent in his eyes!
He punched Hua Wanxian again!
The latter sneered and held his sword to resist!
However, the next moment, the human sword flew out together!
In the air, Hua Wanxian spat out a mouthful of blood, and then hit it hard on the ground. The sword in his hand was also inserted on the floor next to his head.
She wanted to get up again, but her body no longer obeyed her orders.
Even burning blood essence and forcibly using void teleportation are useless!
How is that possible!
Why did he suddenly become stronger again!
She looked in disbelief!
At this time, Xu Yuan had already come to him.
From the side of her head, she held the sword with blood-colored grooves and a strange red glow in her hand.
Xu Yuan's hand brushed the spiritual sword, and the sound of the sword echoed throughout the world!
It seems like this sword is shouting with joy!
The innate sword body can make ten thousand swords surrender!
Holding the sword in his hand, Xu Yuan looked down at the woman and said, "What is this sword called?"
Blood kept pouring out of Hua Wanxian's mouth. She stared at the blue shirt in despair and said:
"The name of the sword is Hua Chen."
Hua Chen?
Moonlight and flowers in the morning!
Xu Yuan thought about the name for a moment, then shook his head and said: "It's too unpleasant. Let's call it Blood Killing from now on."
The blood-killing sword trembled again and let out a sword cry, seeming to express satisfaction with the new name!
Hua Wanxian stared at the sword in disbelief, "This sword has a spirit?"
She has used this sword for several years and killed countless people, but she never knew it!
Xu Yuan smiled and said: "All swords have spirit, but you are not worthy enough to let him recognize his master."
After saying that, cut it off with one sword!
Thousands of flowers bloom, the fragrance disappears and the jade dies!
It's a pity that it's too late, Xu Yuan's figure has appeared in front of Xu Xiaofan in the next moment!
At this time, the old man in red was ready to take action!
But suddenly there was someone next to him, and he was still frightened to the spot, "You..."
Xu Yuan frowned and said, "Who did you just say make life worse than death?"
The old man in red clothes felt the aura of the man in green clothes in front of him and trembled with fear.
